title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double With Gallery Rail Solid Brass Wall Mount | Flat Troll Blue | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
short_title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double, Flat Troll Blue
description:
Get countertop-clearing storage right where you need it with a wall-mounted double glass shelf designed for everyday bathroom essentials in Flat Troll Blue, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary bathroom designs.

Highlights:
- Flat Troll Blue creates a distinctive focal point
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Count on strength and safety with 3/8-inch thick tempered glass
- Enjoy a refined, coordinated look with the Waverly Place collection for transitional bath accessories
- Install with a clean finish using concealed screw mounting hardware and included installation hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Glass dimensions (each shelf): 16 x 5 inches
- Overall size: 16 in L x 8 in H x 5 in projection
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Materials: solid brass hardware with tempered glass shelves
- Mounting: wall mount (concealed screw mount)
- Assembly: not required
- Includes: glass shelf set and all installation hardware (#8 x 1 1/4" screws)
multiple designer finish options available for matching Waverly Place and versatile bath accessories
